scope: Kona held-input vert flow, shared transition edges and wall contact; existing 2x scale retained

baseline.note: Diagnostic centre starts held Up through the air. The final matrix adds full-width and angled routes, so aggregate results are not a paired benchmark.

heldInput.note: 60 Hz; movement comes from real production inputs after fixture placement. No manual jump release or velocity injection forces the tested hangs. Frame travel includes ordinary movement at speed.

slowerTransitions.note: Low-speed runs may roll back below the lip; they must remain supported and return safely.

browser.liteNote: Earlier iteration before the final variable-height edge stitch; the final full-render pass repeats all ten cases after that change.
browser.playableLoad: Verified full-render scene, supported mounted player, four lives, zero console errors
